The word audacity translates into Polish as zuchwałość or śmiałość. It means boldness that is striking or unexpected, often because it seems rude or disrespectful; it can also describe admirable courage.

» She had the audacity to question the decision in front of the whole team.
» His audacity helped him ask for a second chance.
» I can't believe they had the audacity to charge us twice.
